definitions.gloss: common-law marriage; de facto marriage; unmarried cohabitation
definitions.explanation: A relationship in which a couple lives together as married partners without being legally registered as married.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{内縁|ないえん}{関係|かんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The two are in a common-law relationship.

examples.japanese: {内縁|ないえん}の{妻|つま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法的|ほうてき}→法的：13300_houteki⟧⟦{権利|けんり}→権利：02711_kenri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A common-law wife also has certain legal rights.

examples.japanese: {内縁|ないえん}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{財産|ざいさん}→財産：01635_zaisan⟧{分与|ぶんよ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even when dissolving a common-law relationship, division of property may be recognized.

notes:
⟦{内|ない}→〜内：09853_nai⟧ (inside, private) + ⟦{縁|えん}→縁：02182_en⟧ (bond, relation). Refers to a marital-like relationship without formal registration at the municipal office. In Japan, marriage requires submitting a ⟦{婚姻届|こんいんとどけ}→婚姻届：22413_konintodoke⟧ (marriage registration) to be legally recognized, so couples who live together without doing so are considered {内縁|ないえん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内縁|ないえん}{関係|かんけい} — common-law relationship
- {内縁|ないえん}の{妻|つま} — common-law wife
- {内縁|ないえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夫|おっと}→夫：00982_otto⟧ — common-law husband
- {内縁|ないえん}{関係|かんけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解消|かいしょう}する→解消する：21324_kaishousuru⟧ — dissolve a common-law relationship

LEGAL NOTE:
Japanese courts recognize certain rights for {内縁|ないえん} partners, including some property rights and rights to damages if the relationship is broken without just cause. However, {内縁|ないえん} partners do not have inheritance rights unless specified by will.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事実婚|じじつこん}→事実婚：17714_jijitsukon⟧ — de facto marriage — a more modern and neutral term
- ⟦{同棲|どうせい}→同棲：11903_dousei⟧ — cohabitation; living together — does not imply a marriage-like commitment
